name: BMIT SmartCity Data Centre
notes: Colocation facility at SmartCity Malta (Building SCM02, Level 2), Kalkara; BMIT official blog announces EUR 3m investment (29 Apr 2015) consolidating its position as Malta's largest data centre provider; DataCenterMap lists it as operational; no public MW figure.

name: Heritage Malta Data Centre (Bighi)
developer: Heritage Malta (Ministry for Culture, Lands and Local Government)
notes: Official Heritage Malta press release (25 Nov 2025): newly established data centre at the agency's Head Office in Bighi, Kalkara, with a mirrored facility being set up at the Grand Master's Palace, Valletta; internal public-sector digital-heritage facility, not commercial colocation; no public MW figure.

name: GO Data Centre Marsa
notes: Directory-listed colocation facility at Fra Diego Street, Marsa (MRS1501); GO plc official wholesale/hosting pages confirm its hosting/colo offering but the facility address remains directory-level only; no public MW figure; PA/operator primary confirmation still outstanding.

name: Enemalta/Streamcast Underground Data Centre (Marsa)
notes: Officially launched Nov 2017 (EUR 75m programme; EUR 5m pilot) with equipment in Enemalta's underground Marsa facilities and Prime Minister inauguration in 2018; later reporting (The Shift News, Jul 2024; DataCenterMap 'declared dead') says Streamcast abandoned the site leaving unpaid rent and debts - recorded conservatively as rejected/abandoned per MT methodology.

name: Malta Internet Exchange (MIX) at University of Malta Computing Services Centre
developer: NIC (Malta) / University of Malta Computing Services Centre
notes: National Internet exchange hosted at the University of Malta Computing Services Centre, Msida; interconnection/network infrastructure rather than commercial colocation (per MT methodology treat as lead, not a colo census entry); no public MW figure; official facility page confirming a commercial datacentre service still outstanding.
